title: Ijwi riturutse hanze
intro: Uhagaze mu mujyi aho intumwa eshatu zaje zifite ibimenyetso bisobanutse, ariko abantu barabaseka kandi bagakomeza inzira zabo za kera. Uturutse mu gice cya kure cy'umujyi, umuntu yiruka yegereye imbaga y'abantu, afite umwuka kandi yiyemeje kuvuga ukuri mu gihe banze kwemera. Ni nde uyu muntu washyize byose mu kaga kubera ubutumwa butari ubwabo?
clues: Nabaye mu bantu bakiriye intumwa zifite ibimenyetso bisobanutse, nyamara bahindukirira Imana mu bwibone.
Naje ndiruka mvuye mu gice cya kure cy'umujyi ubwo numvaga ihamagara ry'intumwa.
Nabwiye abantu banjye nti: 'Yemwe bantu banjye, nimukurikire intumwa. Nimukurikire abatabasaba ibihembo, kuko bayobowe neza.'
Ntabwo nari umuhanuzi, ariko nizeraga intumwa kandi ngashishikariza n'ubwoko bwanjye kubikora.
Abaturage banjye bansebye inama zanjye kandi banshinja kuba ndi intagondwa.
Ubwo banyicaga, Allah yambwiye kwinjira muri Paradizo, kandi nifuzaga ko abantu banjye bamenya imbabazi n'icyubahiro nahawe.

identity.label: Ndi nde?
options: Umugabo wo mu gace ka kure k'umujyi (Ya-Sin)
Umwe mu ntumwa eshatu zoherejwe mu mujyi
Umucuruzi ukomeye wo muri uwo mujyi
identity.answer: Umugabo wo mu gace ka kure k'umujyi (Ya-Sin)

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Kubaka ubwato kugira ngo burokore abizera mu myuzure

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Yinjiye muri Paradizo maze yifuza ko abantu be bamenya imbabazi ze
Yarohamye n'abantu be kubera kwanga ubutumwa
Yarokowe na Allah kandi agumana n'abantu be
outcome.answer: Yinjiye muri Paradizo maze yifuza ko abantu be bamenya imbabazi ze

arabic: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know (36:26)
